body_lead: Hyderabad: With schools worldwide embracing new technologies and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to improve education, the Telangana government is also set to introduce AI-driven learning methods to enhance the quality of education across the state. Under the Congress leadership, the School Education Department has developed a plan to integrate AI and digital tools into classrooms. As part of this initiative, State Education Secretary Dr. Yogita Rana led a team to the ExStep Foundation in Bengaluru on Thursday.
